description: A field event: JS run by the low-code SDK on the SOURCE field, the mechanism for every computed value since Kissflow has no formula/computed field type.
notes: Put the event on the SOURCE field(s) being read, never on the computed TARGET — an event on the target only fires when a human edits it, which for a computed field never happens.
The editor parses the pasted script as a plain function body: a top-level `await` is a SyntaxError there. Wrap everything in `(async () => { ... })();` as shown.
`kf` is already injected into that scope; `KFSDK` is undefined and calling `KFSDK.initialize()` fails — that call is only for custom components, a different host.

Trigger "onChange" is the only wire-string confirmed live. Per the docs the trigger name depends on field TYPE (On Select for Date/Number/User/Currency/Email/Radio/Slider, On Change for Text/Textarea/Multi-select/Checkbox/Lookup/Rating, On Click for Button/Dropdown/Yes-No) — those other two strings are UNVERIFIED, capture before writing them.
No events are possible on Attachment/Image/Rich text/Signature/SequenceNumber/Geolocation fields — the Event tab does not exist for those types in the builder.
The SDK is read+update only (no create/delete) — an event can fill fields and child-table rows but can never create a field, a table, or a row.
